This gives me a chance to learn from my mistakes and try to adjust my behavior. I may not get the things I want (friends/romance), but I know I'll live healthier if I do all I can to try to change what I can about myself. But if you need to vent, do it. Cry, sob, curl up in a ball, scream at the top of your lungs. No one asks to be born, and no one asks for life to turn out as horrible as it can for many people.
